name: lance_encoding::encoder::encode_batch
behavior: Public async encode_batch is a memory helper primarily for tests/benchmarks/IPC, not a complete Lance file serializer. It rejects non-power-of-two or alignment<8 via InvalidInput. The is_pwr_two call executes first: n-1 underflows for0 with overflow checks enabled, so zero can panic before the intended Result; without overflow checks the subsequent minimum test rejects it. (rust/lance-core/src/utils/bit.rs:15-16) Derive encoding schema from batch.schema(), force keep_original_array=true regardless of supplied option, construct encoders, then prepare all root arrays before maybe_encode. Preparation errors return before any maybe_encode, subject to custom prepare implementations honoring no-mutation. Supplied Arc<Schema> is not used for dispatch or checked for agreement; it is returned later unchanged. Process roots sequentially. Start external reservation at current byte length, use fresh RepDefBuilder and row_number0, maybe_encode then flush before awaiting any task. Append external payload buffers without their reserved padding; await tasks in vector order and bucket PageInfo by encoded_page.column_idx. This helper introduces no concurrent task polling or spawn, although tasks may encapsulate work already dispatched by encoders. After all tasks for a root complete, create fresh external reservation, await finish, append returned external buffers unpadded, then serialize each column-scoped buffer unpadded while recording offsets/actual sizes. Column enumeration uses cumulative count of previous finish results, not returned mapping or encoder.num_columns. Append each EncodedColumn.final_pages to the bucket identified by each page column_idx, then remove pages for current enumerated physical column into ColumnInfo. Missing bucket yields empty pages. Buckets with unreported indices or pages arriving after their column was removed can remain discarded at root-loop end. Correct ordering/index membership is an implicit strategy contract, not validated. top_level_columns collects every allocated mapping index and discards field IDs, including nested leaf allocations; it is not necessarily one index per schema root. Freeze Bytes and return supplied schema plus batch row count. All intermediate Result errors propagate; no partial EncodedBatch is returned. Dropping the future drops its local state and unawaited task futures; behavior of already spawned codec work is outside this helper.
